Name: Soli Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]There was a request in the forums to revive [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8254]Soli - New Skeleton NPC[/url] for 1.6, and since Mr.Bob gave permission for an update, I took the liberty of updating him![/size]

[size=4]Soli is a late-game NPC. You won't meet him until you reach Ginger Island. He has a small cave on the north side of the island. He is dateable, and positively bone-tiful with humerus puns![/size]

[size=4]Nothing is required besides SMAPI and Content Patcher. Simply download and install in your mod folder as usual. [/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
